scope: All 211 original failed trials, after each primary report is saved. Cross review is a second manual evidence check, never another model experiment or subject execution.
requirements: Read the complete primary report and inspect original public task, final patch portions and trajectory windows needed to verify its substantive claims. Do not accept a report only because quotes and hashes pass.

Check concrete input, object, operation and observation relationships against the original tests. Distinguish joint checks absent, existing but unselected/blocked, nondiscriminating observations and incorrect/unhandled feedback.
Check public requirement support, preserving uncertain interpretations; do not force every untested property or every static bug into combination gaps.
Verify actual test selections, reachable assertions, process completion and the relationship to final product/test versions.

Verify all three requested questions have concrete evidence and specific program-analysis/method implications. Preserve contrary evidence and separate observable development facts from mental-state hypotheses.
Read only original public evidence. No hidden tests, reference implementations, later generated test witnesses or new subject execution.

Each signoff states the primary report SHA, reviewer different from its primary owner, actual inspected files and steps, claim-specific decisions, corrections and limitations. A changed primary report invalidates its earlier receipt until checked again.
mechanical_note: Checking receipts and signoff membership is not proof of semantic correctness. Claim checks must explain the actual inspection.
